newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's Viravan says has no plans to quit.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Viravan says has no plans to quit.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said on Monday he had no plan to quit despite talk that some coalition partners in Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh government are seeking to have him replaced.

"I have never given any thought to resigning," he said in response to questions by reporters if he was discouraged by talk of a new move by some in the administration wanting to have his finance portfolio changed.
Amnuay made the statement before meeting Chavalit at Government House. It was not immediately known what they discussed.
Chavalit and Chatichai Choonhavan, leader of the senior coalition partner Chart Pattana Party, denied any knowledge of a plan to change personalities the finance ministerial job.

Some unidentified politicians in the government have been quoted by the Thai press as saying that Amnuay failed to restore market confidence in the battered Thai economy since he took office last December.
Amnuay dismissed the reported move to unseat him as unfounded and said the talk did not dampen his spirit to carry on working.
